/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
# Recompute final distances with selected sequences
import json, os, urllib.request, urllib.parse

def lev(a,b):
    if a==b: return 0
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    if n<m: a,b=b,a; n,m=len(a),len(b)
    prev=list(range(m+1))
    for i,ca in enumerate(a,1):
        cur=[i]+[0]*m
        for j,cb in enumerate(b,1):
            cur[j]=min(prev[j]+1,cur[j-1]+1,prev[j-1]+(ca"'!=cb))
        prev=cur
    return prev[m]

def readfa(p): return '"''.join(open(p).read().splitlines()[1:])

# human
human=readfa('NM_000193.4.fasta')[341:641]
open('human_segment.txt','w').write(human)
print('human',len(human),human)

# selected species sequences
seqs={}
# NCBI-derived for annotated species
products={}
for line in open('species_products.jsonl'):
    j=json.loads(line)
    for t in j.get('transcripts',[]):
        products[t['accession_version']]=(j.get('taxname'),t)
for acc in ['XM_001147185.7','XM_001106515.5','XM_034965340.4','XM_034650041.1','XM_022576607.2']:
    tax,t=products[acc]
    s=readfa(f'{acc}.fasta')
    cds=int(t['cds']['range'][0]['begin'])
    e1len=int(t['genomic_locations'][0]['exons'][0]['end'])-int(t['genomic_locations'][0]['exons'][0]['begin'])+1
    seg=s[cds-1:e1len]
    seqs[tax]=seg
    print(tax,acc,'seg_len',len(seg),'dist',lev(human,seg))

# Indri/Sem from blast full-length sseq
seqs['Indri indri']=''
seqs['Semnopithecus johnii']=''
for k in ['Indri indri','Semnopithecus johnii']:
 print(k,len(seqs[k]),'dist',lev(human,seqs[k]))

order=['Pan troglodytes','Macaca mulatta','Pan paniscus','Indri indri','Semnopithecus johnii','Ailuropoda melanoleuca','Delphinapterus leucas']
print('FINAL',','.join(str(lev(human,seqs[s])) for s in order))
PY"
